annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act binds motor vehicle owners, motor vehicle manufacturers, sellers, etc. (manufacturers, assemblers, importers), motor vehicle management business entities, and the Minister and Mayors/Do Governors.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A person who intends to run a motor vehicle management business shall have it registered with the head of a Si/Gun/Gu
annotation.dates_quote: This Act shall enter into force 1 year and 6 months after the date of its promulgation; provided, the amended provisions of Article 29-3 shall enter into force one year after the date of its promulgation
annotation.robot_provision_quote: The term "autonomous vehicle" means a motor vehicle which can self operate without any operation by its driver or passenger;
